title: FailBody
description:
The `POST /tasks/fail` request body (soma#281, EST-186) — the terminal
report for a run the runner gave up on: blackwall 404 (unresolved, never
re-dispatched), watch-budget expiry, repeated dispatch failure. A runner
never leaves a task `assigned`.

error.description:
The reason, non-empty (escapement rejects a blank one with 400 and
retains at most 2048 chars).

id.description: The task id — the action id.

result.description:
The partial custody record, when the run got far enough to have one
(`custody`, blackwall `job_id`, `exit: err`).

Exit.description: How the run ended, as the runner reports it.

TaskResult.description:
The runner's report — the `result` object of `POST /tasks/complete`,
carried verbatim on the completed [`JobView`] (bounded, 8 KiB).

`custody` names WHERE the run's record lives: `"blackwall-serve"` for
the in-cluster runner (EST-185), `"fleet:<agent>"` for the workstation
shim's local store. A card surfaced from fleet custody is real but its
settle hop resolves against blackwall-serve, which never saw the run —
which is why the value is carried onto the card rather than hidden.

changeset.description: The run's changeset hash, if the executor produced one.

containment_attestation.description:
blackwall-serve's signed containment attestation: the exact text of
`JobStatus.containment_attestation` (CER-2276 §5), a
[`crate::attestation::SignedContainmentAttestation`]. It has always
been null so far; the runner has never filled it. The runner
copies these bytes and never parses or rebuilds them, so a change in
transit is visible against serve's own record. It counts against the
8 KiB result bound; an attestation that does not fit fails the run and
is never truncated.

custody.description:
Where the custody record lives. Absent = unknown, which a consumer
must render as unknown, never as "in the cluster".

exit.description:
Absent on the wire reads as [`Exit::Unknown`]: escapement bounds the
object at 8 KiB and says nothing about which keys must be present.

job_id.description: blackwall-serve's ULID job id, when the run went through serve.

run_hash.description:
blackwall's content-addressed run hash — the durable custody pointer.
Present iff the run completed under custody; the runner captures it
at report time because after a pod replacement the job id resolves
to nothing.

run_hash_prefix.description: The workstation shim's fallback when it could only recover a prefix.

world.description: The world commit linking parent → child tree.
